name: broaden_beat_to_beat_jitter
mechanism: The child widens per-beat amplitude and width jitter ranges so each cardiac cycle has more physiologically plausible waveform diversity, reducing stereotyped morphology and improving embedding spread.

name: component_specific_lead_ratios
mechanism: Independent subject-level Lead I/II projection ratios are assigned to P, Q, R, S, and T waves so the two leads are no longer exact scaled copies, increasing inter-sample physiological diversity.

name: asymmetric_pqrs_subwave_generation
mechanism: Replace symmetric Gaussian P, Q, R, and S subwaves with asymmetric Gaussian waveforms using component-specific skew parameters for fast upstrokes and slower recoveries, increasing morphological realism and inter-sample diversity.

name: tighten_qrs_duration_constraints
mechanism: Narrowing synthetic QRS duration into the normal 80-100 ms range by constraining Q/R/S subwave widths, offsets, skew ranges, and beat-to-beat jitter.
code_snippet: qrs_dur_scale = rng.uniform(0.94, 1.04); q_offset = -0.019 * qrs_dur_scale; s_offset = 0.032 * qrs_dur_scale; r_sigma_base = rng.uniform(0.010, 0.014) * qrs_dur_scale
